Thanks for the context — good catch on the encoded accented character. Quick troubleshooting notes from infra:

- Our onboarding service expects the tenant identifier to be normalized to Unicode Normalization Form C (NFC). Some clients (notably Safari) normalize differently when constructing redirect URLs, and percent-encoding can interact badly with the connector that maps tenant slugs to Workday tenants.
- The Workday SAML connector uses relayState + tenant param. If relayState contains a percent-encoded UTF-8 string that the connector doesn't re-decode consistently, we can miss the tenant mapping.

What I need from you, Emma (if possible):
- The raw SAML response or assertion (base64) from the failing attempt — even a copy/paste dump is fine.
- Browser version (you included Safari 17.1, thank you) and whether you used a bookmark or an email link.

Temporary workaround for Polaris: I generated a one-time ASCII-safe activation link that maps to your account on our side (non-public token). It will bypass the tenant parse and let you finish onboarding and upload POs. Use: https://console.redwood.ai/onboard/one-time-token/abc123 (expires in 8 hours).

I'll open a ticket to change the onboarding service to NFC-normalize incoming tenant params and add a small idempotent decoder for relayState in the Workday connector. I'll include the ticket number in this thread once created.

-Ben
